name: High Row
instructions: Sit at the high row machine with chest against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at full contraction.
Extend slowly. Targets the upper back and rear delts.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner machine pull-pattern exercise for the upper back. High Row strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
